composition: Retain the 606 complete parent chains and replace only the five listed conflicted chains with this date-sorted delta. Preserve earlier histories; never splice pages or treat their union as a completed cursor traversal.
limitations: Queries are unchanged name-co-occurrence searches, not exact compound or biological evidence.
The 1000-row cursor chain is separate from historical 100-row caches; counts may change.
Completion means unique rows equal the reported hit count across consistent cached pages.
Europe PMC is live: consistent counts and API versions do not prove an atomic index snapshot.
Added citations are relative to one original query page, not all citations for the record.
A shared query retains each record/name membership without merging chemical identities.
No abstracts, full text, sequences, new gene/allele, protein, taxon or AST assignments exported.
All candidates require primary review; search completion does not establish biological absence.
A conflicting page is rejected in full and pinned separately; only its valid prefix is retained.
Conflicted queries remain incomplete and are not retried by resuming the same cursor chain.
Only complete parent query chains are reused; the five retried chains remain separately identifiable.
No pages from separate attempts are spliced into a chain, and earlier valid prefixes remain available.
Only the sort parameter changes; source names, query text, result type and synonym setting do not.
The default and date-sorted canary sets agree, but this does not establish why earlier attempts conflicted.
The live index is not an atomic snapshot, even if all reported-count and identity checks pass.
Short aliases and stop words can create unrelated hits; no relevance estimate or biological absence is inferred.
All 2939 records remain in scope; citation traversal does not complete primary or allele review.
network: EMBL-EBI Europe PMC only; no NCBI request, outreach or source adoption.

ordering_canary.interpretation: Both fresh attempts completed; no cause is assigned to sorting or earlier conflicts.
